name: ICT Silver Bullet NY AM MES
description: 10-11 AM ET Silver Bullet — displacement FVG entry within the NY AM killzone. Price sweeps a prior high/low, creates a Fair Value Gap on the displacement candle, then retraces into the FVG for entry. Targets prior dealing range extreme.
entry_condition: Within 10-11 AM ET window: price sweeps a prior high or low, forms a displacement candle with a Fair Value Gap, then retraces 50% or more back into the FVG for entry.
